info.title: Nivra HTTP API
info.description: Session-authenticated web operations and scoped bearer API-key content access. Write includes read. Agents can move active items to Trash and list deleted items, but cannot restore, change trashed items, or permanently delete content. OAuth remains an MCP interface. Lists return a bounded items array and an explicit next cursor. BlockNote JSON is canonical. Custom calendar/document validation applies in addition to JSON Schema constraints.
